title: [Main][ALL-E] Sales Price from customer card and Purcase Price from vendor card is showing "All Customers/All Vendors" as header instead of the specific customer/vendor informationInitial  commit
summary: The Price List Lines page now displays the correct customer or vendor name in its caption when opened from a customer or vendor card, instead of showing 'All Customers' or 'All Vendors'.
key_points: Fixed caption display to show specific customer/vendor instead of universal price source
Reordered price source list to place universal source before specific sources
Preserved filtering behavior for universal price lines
Added regression tests for customer and vendor price list captions
